arxiv-1510-02435.title: Information equilibrium as an economic principle
arxiv-1510-02435.creator: Jason Smith
arxiv-1510-02435.description: Abstract A general information equilibrium model in the case of ideal information transfer is defined and then used to derive the relationship between supply (information destination) and demand (information source) with the price as the detector of information exchange between demand and supply. We recover the properties of the traditional economic supply-demand diagram.

arxiv-2204-01909.title: Locality of vortex stretching for the 3D Euler equations
arxiv-2204-01909.creator: Yuuki Shimizu, Tsuyoshi Yoneda
arxiv-2204-01909.description: Abstract . We consider the 3D incompressible Euler equations under the following situation: small-scale vortex blob being stretched by a prescribed large-scale stationary flow. More precisely, we clarify what kind of large-scale stationary flows really stretch small-scale vortex blobs in alignment with the straining direction.

arxiv-2204-08375.title: Orbit pseudometrics and a universality property of the Gromov-Hausdorff distance Thanks: The author was supported by the GAČR project 20-22230L and RVO: 67985840.
arxiv-2204-08375.creator: Ondřej Kurka
arxiv-2204-08375.description: Abstract . We consider the notion of Borel reducibility between pseudometrics on standard Borel spaces introduced and studied recently by Cúth, Doucha and Kurka, as well as the notion of an orbit pseudometric, a continuous version of the notion of an orbit equivalence relation.

arxiv-2211-07804.title: Diffusion Models in Medical Imaging: A Comprehensive Survey
arxiv-2211-07804.creator: Amirhossein Kazerouni, Ehsan Khodapanah Aghdam, Moein Heidari, Reza Azad, Mohsen Fayyaz, Ilker Hacihaliloglu, Dorit Merhof
arxiv-2211-07804.description: Abstract Denoising diffusion models, a class of generative models, have garnered immense interest lately in various deep-learning problems. A diffusion probabilistic model defines a forward diffusion stage where the input data is gradually perturbed over several steps by adding Gaussian noise and then learns to reverse the diffusion process to retrieve the desired noise-free data from noisy data samples.

arxiv-2306-11132.title: Fairness-aware Message Passing for Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2306-11132.creator: Huaisheng Zhu, Guoji Fu, Zhimeng Guo, Zhiwei Zhang, Teng Xiao, Suhang Wang
arxiv-2306-11132.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Huaisheng Zhu, Guoji Fu, Zhimeng Guo, Zhiwei Zhang, Teng Xiao, Suhang Wang. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have shown great power in various domains. However, their predictions may inherit societal biases on sensitive attributes, limiting their adoption in real-world applications.

arxiv-2407-10054.title: The feasibility of sound zone control using an array of parametric array loudspeakers
arxiv-2407-10054.description: Abstract Parametric array loudspeakers (PALs) are known for producing highly directional audio beams, a feat more challenging to achieve with conventional electro-dynamic loudspeakers (EDLs). Due to their intrinsic physical mechanisms, PALs hold promising potential for spatial audio applications such as virtual reality (VR).

pmc-11489308.title: Increasing Trends of Artificial Intelligence With Robotic Process Automation in Health Care: A Narrative Review
pmc-11489308.creator: Prashant Nimkar, Deepika Kanyal, Shantanu R Sabale
pmc-11489308.description: This review explores the fast-growing importance of artificial intelligence (AI) with robotic process automation (RPA) in healthcare. AI uses intelligent algorithms to analyze data, while RPA automates repetitive tasks to improve efficiency and accuracy. These technologies are swiftly revolutionizing health care by improving diagnostic precision, accelerating administrative tasks, reducing operation timing, and improving patient care.

pmc-11574145.title: Circulating blood circular RNA in Parkinson’s Disease; from involvement in pathology to diagnostic tools in at-risk individuals
pmc-11574145.creator: Aleksandra Beric, Yichen Sun, Santiago Sanchez, Charissa Martin, Tyler Powell, Ravindra Kumar, Jose Adrian Pardo, Gauri Darekar, Jessie Sanford, Devin Dikec, Bridget Phillips, Juan A Botia, Carlos Cruchaga, Laura Ibanez
pmc-11574145.description: To identify circRNAs associated with Parkinson’s disease (PD) we leveraged two of the largest publicly available studies with longitudinal clinical and blood transcriptomic data. We performed a cross-sectional study utilizing the last visit of each participant (N = 1848), and a longitudinal analysis that included 1166 participants with at least two time points.

pmc-11615372.title: Role of ATP citrate lyase and its complementary partner on fatty acid synthesis in gastric cancer
pmc-11615372.creator: Chunlei Li, Wenxuan Liu, Youzhao Liu, Weixing Wang, Wenhong Deng
pmc-11615372.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ATP citrate lyase (ACLY) and acyl-CoA short-chain synthetases 2 (ACSS2) are key enzymes in lipid metabolism. We explored the role of ACLY in gastric cancer (GC) and the effect of ACLY and ACSS2 compensation on GC growth. We used immunohistochemistry to verify the expression level of ACLY in GC, shRNA to stably knock down the expression level of ACLY in GC cells.

pmc-11682769.title: Molecular docking of eleven snake venom peptides targeting human immunodeficiency virus capsid glycoprotein as inhibitors
pmc-11682769.creator: Mousa O Germoush, Maged Fouda, Mohammad J S Mantargi, Moustafa Sarhan, Barakat M Alrashdi, Diaa Massoud, Sarah Alzwain, Nehmat Ghaboura, Ahmed E Altyar, Mohamed M Abdel-Daim
pmc-11682769.description: Background:Snake venoms are mainly composed of a mixture of proteins and peptides with antiviral activity against several viruses including HIV. Therefore, snake venoms represent a promising source for new antiviral drugs.Aim:The study examines the toxin’s capacity to disrupt the spike glycoprotein of HIV, the virus accountable for the HIV epidemic.

pmc-12374283.title: Simultaneous online monitoring of viscosity and oxygen transfer rate in shake flask cultures
pmc-12374283.creator: René Hanke, Michaela Sieben, Maurice Finger, Kilian Schnoor, Simon Jeßberger, Julia Weyand, Lluìs Coloma de la Fuente, Marcel Mann, Amizon Azizan, Udo Kosfeld, Jochen Büchs
pmc-12374283.description: Shake flasks are among the most relevant culture vessels for early-stage process development of viscous microbial cultures. While online process monitoring systems are available for temperature, pH, biomass concentration, dissolved oxygen tension and respiration activity, online measuring techniques for viscosity are not yet commercially available.

pmc-12619450.title: Truth-telling and devastating disclosures Navigating the tension between ethical and cultural obligations in Saudi Arabia
pmc-12619450.creator: Ruaim A Muaygil, Noura A Abouammoh, Abdossalam M Madkhali, Lyan H Almana, Raniah N Aldekhyyel
pmc-12619450.description: BackgroundTruth-telling is the process by which relevant medical information is disclosed to the patient to enable them to make informed decisions about their healthcare. It serves multiple aims; first, it is essential to adequately informed consent; second, it respects patients’ rights to self-determination, third, it fulfills practitioners’ ethical obligations; and fourth, it promotes trust between patients and practitioners.

pmc-12692600.title: Organokine-Mediated Crosstalk: A Systems Biology Perspective on the Pathogenesis of MASLD—A Narrative Review
pmc-12692600.creator: Sandra Maria Barbalho, Lucas Fornari Laurindo, Vitor Engracia Valenti, Nahum Méndez-Sánchez, Mariana M Ramírez-Mejía, Ricardo de Alvares Goulart, Jacek Baj
pmc-12692600.description: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is a prevalent chronic condition with a complex pathophysiology involving multiple organs. Organokines, including hepatokines, myokines, cardiokines, renokines, osteokines, and adipokines, play central roles in lipid metabolism, glucose homeostasis, inflammation, and fibrosis. Dysregulation of these signaling molecules contributes to the progression of MASLD and its systemic complications.

pmc-12819694.title: Active LXR signaling, coupled with elevated mitochondrial and glycolytic metabolism contributes to GM-CSF–induced trained immunity
pmc-12819694.creator: Yuanyuan Liu, Arslan Hamid, Hannah Hardege, Qian Zhang, Helena Körner, Merle Leffers, Noelia A. Gonzalez, Gerhard Liebisch, Marcus Hoering, Hannes Findeisen, Katarzyna Placek, Mihai G. Netea, Holger Reinecke, Dennis Schwarz, Yahya Sohrabi
pmc-12819694.description: Granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor (GM-CSF) contributes to the host defense and the pathogenesis of inflammatory diseases at least in part through inducing trained immunity (TI), however, the mechanism remains poorly characterized. In this paper, we systematically investigated the associated metabolic and epigenetic reprogramming, with a particular focus on the role of liver X receptors (LXRs) in this process.

pmc-13234050.title: Sparse polynomial surrogates for F-actin networks with compliant crosslinkers
pmc-13234050.creator: Luís Pacheco, Marco Parente, João Ferreira
pmc-13234050.description: Filamentous actin (F-actin) constitutes the primary contributor to cell elasticity and structural integrity, forming dynamic, crosslinked networks in the actin cortex. Existing mechanical models for F-actin and crosslinked filament networks successfully describe filament- and network-level behavior, but are often limited in accounting for biological dynamic processes and inherent material uncertainty and variability.

pmc-13369213.title: Orthokeratology Decentration: Topography Alignment, Tear Profile Symmetry and Induced HOAs
pmc-13369213.creator: Eihab Eltantawy, Emily Field, Catherine Bui, Michael Kang
pmc-13369213.description: PurposeTo assess how topographic rotational misalignment alters orthokeratology (OK) treatment position, symmetry and visual references. A simulated lens-cornea model that predicts treatment position is introduced. A further aim investigated decentration-induced change in higher-order aberrations, root mean square (ΔHOA RMS).MethodsRetrospective analysis of topography from 26 myopic OK wearers was conducted on visual and geometric aligned scans.
